ON YOUR COMPANY'S COMPUTER

Start sensing.

The agent runs locally on Windows, macOS, or Linux with Python 3.10+. Review the source and install it from your private repository.

01

Clone & install

git clone https://github.com/dennybrig/Glinx.ai.git
cd Glinx.ai
python -m pip install .
02

Discover this computer

glinx scan --host --company "My company" --serve

Opens a local dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:8765. On Windows, use py -3 if python is unavailable.

03

Expand the view

Add approved domains, Microsoft 365 app registrations, HTTPS endpoints, or an inventory CSV. See the connector setup in the repository.

The default endpoint scan reads installed application names. It does not read emails, documents, passwords, or browser history. No report is uploaded automatically.
